label: Riyadh
seoTitle: Cable Tray Manufacturer in Riyadh | Osos Al Benaa (OBC)
seoDescription: OBC manufactures cable trays, ladders, trunking and strut channels at its Riyadh factory. Visit our Al Amal showroom or enquire on WhatsApp.
intro: Osos Al Benaa (OBC) manufactures cable management systems in Riyadh. Our factory on Istanbul Street produces cable trays, cable ladders, trunking, strut channels and the fittings that connect them, and our showroom in Al Amal is open for project discussions.

sections.title: Made in Riyadh, close to your site
body: Because we manufacture in the city, Riyadh contractors can talk to the people who make the product. Bring a drawing, a bill of quantities or a sample to the showroom, or ask us to review a cable route before you order.
Standard parts and project-specific brackets and frames come from the same factory, so trays, ladders and their supports can be matched in size and finish.

sections.title: Choosing a finish for Riyadh projects
body: Riyadh's dry inland climate is kind to steel indoors, so GI (pre-galvanized) trays are an economical choice for dry plant rooms and ceiling voids. Hot-dip galvanized steel is the usual choice for rooftops, car parks and other exposed or industrial areas, and stainless steel suits chemical, food and pharmaceutical environments.

label: Jeddah
seoTitle: Cable Tray Supplier in Jeddah | Osos Al Benaa (OBC)
seoDescription: Cable trays, ladders, trunking and supports for projects in Jeddah, made by OBC in Riyadh. Hot-dip galvanized and stainless finishes for the coast.
intro: OBC supplies cable trays, cable ladders, trunking, strut channels and fittings to projects in Jeddah. Everything is manufactured at our factory in Riyadh, and our team handles enquiries for Jeddah projects by phone, email and WhatsApp.

sections.title: Finishes for the Red Sea coast
body: Jeddah's humid, salt-laden air is harder on steel than an inland site. For outdoor runs, car parks, rooftops and plant areas, hot-dip galvanized steel gives a thick zinc coating that stands up to that exposure. Where conditions are more aggressive, such as waterfront and process areas, stainless steel is the safer choice. GI is best kept to dry, air-conditioned interiors.

sections.title: How we supply Jeddah projects
body: Send us your drawings, bill of quantities or product list by WhatsApp or email. We confirm sizes, finishes and quantities, and agree delivery arrangements to your site with you before production.

h1: Cable tray supplier in Dammam and the Eastern Province
intro: OBC supplies cable management systems to projects in Dammam, Al Khobar and across the Eastern Province. Our cable trays, ladders, trunking and strut channels are manufactured at our factory in Riyadh.

sections.title: Built for industrial and coastal sites
body: Industrial plants, power and utility sites in the Eastern Province often carry large power cables over long distances. Cable ladders and heavy-duty trays suit those loads, with strut channels and cantilever arms to support them.
Near the Gulf coast, humidity and salt speed up corrosion. Hot-dip galvanized steel is the standard choice for exposed runs, and stainless steel suits the most aggressive areas.

sections.title: How we supply Eastern Province projects
body: Share your drawings, bill of quantities or product list by WhatsApp or email. We confirm sizes, finishes and quantities, and agree delivery arrangements to your site with you before production.
